capabilities: Auto-export on file save or modification with debouncing
Configure output path, folder scope, delimiter, and header options
Trigger exports via command palette, ribbon icon, or hotkey
Show last export status in the status bar
disambiguation: Not a task manager or tracker; it only reads unchecked tasks and writes them to a CSV file.
extras: Not yet published to the Obsidian community plugin store; manual installation from GitHub Releases is required. The README notes European Excel users may need to switch the CSV delimiter to semicolon.
intentEvidence: This is a TypeScript port of the markdown-task-export C# console application, adapted for Obsidian
motivation: The author built it for personal use managing customer project tasks with time tracking integration, porting their own C# console tool to Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get outstanding tasks out of the vault in a structured CSV format that external time-tracking software can consume.

relations.evidence: This is a TypeScript port of the markdown-task-export C# console application

summary: Task exporter that scans a configured folder for unchecked Markdown tasks and writes them to a CSV file for time-tracking tools like ManicTime.
